newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain may approve Repsol sale on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Spain may approve Repsol sale on Friday.

text.p: Spain may approve the privatisation of its last 10 percent stake in energy group Repsol at this Friday's cabinet meeting, Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Monday, according to local agencies.
No-one at SEPI, the state holding company for Repsol, was available to comment.
A week ago Pique said he expected the government to sell Repsol between the second half of April and the second half of May, market conditions allowing.
Repsol's privatisation is expected to swell state coffers by around 150 billion pesetas, at current share prices.
The state received a total of 607 billion pesetas for the sale of its last 21 percent stake in Telefonica last month.
